limitations: 0082-F1 — False centered-proxy concentration inequality invalidates the central general-noise derivation — Counterevidence: Bounded-uniform special cases can use ordinary bounded differences. Threshold phenomena and empirical curves are not refuted.

0082-F2 — Polynomial-profile sensitivity differentiates with respect to the wrong variable — Counterevidence: The actual source includes absolute-value bars. The global derivative infimum can still be zero as beta tends to infinity; linear-profile conclusions are separate.

0082-F3 — Complementary ability gaps alone do not guarantee positive merging gain — Counterevidence: If the full threshold sandwich is implicitly inherited, the conditional theorem survives. The finding does not refute Theorem 3.3 under all its original assumptions.

proposition.claim:
Each one-sided tail is bounded by exp(-2t^2/sum centered MGF proxies squared).

Absolute beta derivative equals beta/(2n) sum s^(beta-1), implying a local lower bound.

Opposite ability margins of the displayed order imply gain at least 1-2theta for both original workers.
